body:
_shellman_find_root="/path/to/search"
_shellman_find_pattern="criteria"
case $_shellman_find_root in
  -*) _shellman_find_root=./$_shellman_find_root ;;
esac
coproc _shellman_find {
  find "$_shellman_find_root" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$_shellman_find_pattern" -print0
}
# shellcheck disable=SC2154 # Bash sets the named coprocess PID.
_shellman_find_pid=$_shellman_find_PID
readarray -d '' -t resultArray <&"${_shellman_find[0]}"
wait "$_shellman_find_pid"
description: find files (-type f) or directories (-type d) by name or pattern (*.jpg)
